reviews.comment: Best professor I have had so far at TAMU. Professor Mer makes his lectures so engaging it's nearly impossible to not have a good time. I never used the textbook even though I bought it and I got a 99. Don't buy the textbook. He is so understanding I misread a deadline and he reopened it and let me finish it with an extension. 10/10 recommend!!!!!!!

This class consisted of one group project worth 70% of your grade and weekly quizzes, he never lectured - only came around and "helped" us with the project.  He didn't really do much yet was very picky about everything in the project and wanted things done his way.  Not bad but not great.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Mer is a great guy! We had weekly discussions due for a podcast we had to listen to each Tuesday. We had guest speakers which was cool and after we had to reflect on what they talked about. Three tests one is dropped study the review! Everything on the test will be on the review!! This was a class I needed to take but it was great!

Takes best of first 2 exams then final that is non cumulative. Weekly discussion over current events podcast and a few case studys. Exam questions are not trick questions and he took our advice after the first exam. He wants us to succeed

New professor, but pretty good at it. Most of class is discussing current events and economics. If you're not much of the discussion type, then this class will be pretty boring, but still an easy A. Takes the highest grade of your first two exams and then the final. Weekly discussion post that take like 10 minutes. Super easy going.

One of the most kind hearted professors Ive had. He has discussions often about current events and hears everybody out regardless of their political viewpoints. However, I took this class to learn about how I can better learn about marketing and running a business and I feel like I havent learned much. Too many discussions and not enough teaching
